title: A one-period market and its risk-neutral probability
caption: The stock goes from £100 to £120 or £90. Weighting the two prices with q = 1/3 and 2/3 gives back £100, the only probability for which the stock is a fair price when r = 0.
alt: A tree from £100 with an up branch to £120 of probability 1/3 and a down branch to £90 of probability 2/3.
description: The martingale condition is 100 = q × 120 + (1 − q) × 90.
The unique q means every payoff can be priced: the market is complete.
